scope: Offline configuration/asset audit; no signing, native build, external-account verification, upload or publication.

checks.detail: Native name and permanent identifiers must match the listing.
Current source version 1.0.0; choose the public launch version before signing.
Production selects a store AAB / device IPA, remote build numbering and the production environment.
The default Android submit target must remain internal/draft.
English and Spanish must be declared for Apple.
The current image-only upload flow does not need an Android microphone permission. Verify the merged native manifest separately.
EN/ES draft names, subtitles, short/full descriptions and keywords fit store field limits.
Owned support URL and email are present; verify the deployed EN/ES page and end-to-end delivery.
Owner approved the outlined WM identity on October 26; platform assets derive from the committed SVG masters.

detail.requirement: A 1024×1024 opaque PNG master for the iOS/default icon; no baked rounded corners.
Separate transparent foreground; verify safe-area cropping with launcher masks.

checks.detail: Prepare a dedicated monochrome adaptive-icon layer for themed Android launchers. This is a brand quality gate.

detail.requirement: 96×96 visible all-white symbol on genuine transparency, not the colored launcher icon.

checks.detail: Prepare a separate transparent splash mark; inspect a preview/production binary rather than Expo Go.
A source allowlist covers mobile and its sibling shared rules; actual EAS archive inspection is still required.

Owner confirmed PORTILLO'S DESIGN CR LLC, Florida, United States: free couple/vendor accounts, direct vendor payments, sponsored placements off. Verify these answers against the final binary and console declarations.

Web/native source records authenticated deletion requests with a 30-day deadline. Verify MFA processing, origin/CDN/backup handling and confirmation email using an isolated end-to-end drill before submission.

Source includes reports, two-way contact blocks, a first-pass text filter, recorded rules acceptance and MFA moderation. Verify the complete device/moderator workflow and timely report handling before submission.
Verify EAS production public values against the Wedding Market Supabase project and HTTPS website. No environment secrets are read by this audit.
Inspect AAB/IPA permissions, SDK privacy manifests, backup/session storage, consent, media handling and the final privacy declarations.

October 26 npm audit reports five high-severity package findings from two underlying node-forge/Zod advisories through Expo tooling. Review current exposure/remediation before signing; do not force-downgrade Expo to SDK 44.
Verify this app’s FCM/APNs configuration, token ownership/logout, notification icon in the binary, and real-device foreground/background/terminated delivery.
Inspect the EAS archive for both platforms: include shared rules, exclude the web/server repository, secrets, reviewer credentials and signing keys; retain file hashes.
Verify signing identity, package/version, Android API 36+ and 16 KB native-library compatibility, iOS 26+ SDK, size and absence of privileged credentials.
Test Android, iPhone and supported iPad, both roles/languages, auth callbacks/recovery, independent bookings, uploads, accessibility and slow/offline recovery with isolated records.
Capture final native screens with fictional data. Complete privacy, age/content rating, app access, audience, countries and trader declarations in each console.
Verify Wedding Market app records, credentials, name availability and any account-specific closed-testing requirements. No store-console state was checked here.
